task: Learn the UK and US pronunciation of the word "procrastination", and find one example sentence that reflects its use in context.
answer:
FINAL: Procrastination — UK /prəˌkræs.tɪˈneɪ.ʃən/; US /proʊˌkræs.tɪˈneɪ.ʃən/. Both stress “NAY” (the syllable /neɪ/).
Example: “This is no time for procrastination - we need decisive action.”
Here, procrastination means delaying something that needs to be done.
Evidence: Cambridge Dictionary, https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/procrastination (accessed 27 October 2026). Screenshot: ./final.png shows the word, both pronunciations, definition and example sentence.
